title: Wrong collector name for blukon
symptom: Under system, it still shows "LimiTTer" as collector. In system status, field Collection Method has wrong value for Blucon (should be Ambrosia Blucon/Blucon/Libre Bluetooth not LimiTTer).
fix: The issue was fixed after getting one reading, as stated by gregorybel: 'fixed after getting one reading'. Additionally, jamorham reworked the 'Classic Status' page for more sophisticated hardware naming.
